name: batch
title: Run commands atomically.
description: Run commands atomically. Run commands atomically. See describe for errors and examples.

name: branch_create
title: Start a branch from a branch's head (default: the current one) and switch to it.
description: Start a branch from a branch's head (default: the current one) and switch to it. Agents: work on agent/<you>/<topic> branches, then branch.diff and branch.merge into main. Merging replays your edits onto main even if main moved; conflicting edits are reported. See describe for errors and examples.

name: branch_delete
title: Delete a branch (not main, not the current one).
description: Delete a branch (not main, not the current one).  See describe for errors and examples.

name: branch_diff
title: What differs between two branch heads: objects added, removed, changed (fields).
description: What differs between two branch heads: objects added, removed, changed (fields).  See describe for errors and examples.

name: branch_list
title: List branches and the current one.
description: List branches and the current one.  See describe for errors and examples.

name: branch_merge
title: Merge a branch into another (default: main) by replaying its edits.
description: Merge a branch into another (default: main) by replaying its edits. Fast-forwards when the target has not moved. Otherwise replays the branch's edits; IDs it created are renumbered where needed (see remapped). If both sides changed the same field of an object, nothing is merged and the error lists each conflict. See describe for errors and examples.

name: branch_switch
title: Make another branch current (edits, undo and playback follow it).
description: Make another branch current (edits, undo and playback follow it).  See describe for errors and examples.

name: engine_start
title: Start real-time playback on the audio device (jack) or without one (dummy).
description: Start real-time playback on the audio device (jack) or without one (dummy). backend: jack (default; PipeWire's JACK or a JACK server) or dummy (no device, paced like one). block: the device block in frames (default 256); the device's period may differ and is reported. anticipative (default true): render ahead of the playhead on worker threads (edits are heard up to 200 ms later); false renders everything in the audio callback. The project must run at the device's rate. See describe for errors and examples.

name: engine_status
title: Real-time engine state: backend, rate, block, device period, latency, xruns.
description: Real-time engine state: backend, rate, block, device period, latency, xruns. plan_latency: the session's plugin delay in frames; device_latency: frames from the engine's outputs to the device. restart_needed: the device changed rate or went away; engine.stop and engine.start again. failed_fx: isolated plugins whose process crashed or hung (silent now; fx.restart re-creates them). See describe for errors and examples.

name: engine_stop
title: Stop real-time playback and release the audio device.
description: Stop real-time playback and release the audio device.  See describe for errors and examples.

name: env_add
title: Automate a parameter: a track's or route's mixer control, or a plugin's.
description: Automate a parameter: a track's or route's mixer control, or a plugin's. Target one of track (param volume|trim|pan|width|mute), route (volume|pan|mute) or fx (a semantic key such as "gain" or "filter1.cutoff", or for other plugins a CLAP id or parameter name). points: [{beat|bar|seconds, value, shape?, tension?}]; values in the parameter's unit (dB, %, Hz… — text like "800 Hz" works for plugins); shapes linear, square, slow, fast_start, fast_end, bezier. Plugin values move along the parameter's curve (a log cutoff sweeps evenly in pitch). See describe for errors and examples.

name: env_list
title: List envelopes (optionally of one track, route or plugin).
description: List envelopes (optionally of one track, route or plugin).  See describe for errors and examples.

name: env_points_set
title: Replace an envelope's points (all of them, or those in a beat range).
description: Replace an envelope's points (all of them, or those in a beat range). from_beat/to_beat: replace only points with from_beat <= beat < to_beat. See describe for errors and examples.

name: env_remove
title: Remove an envelope (the parameter returns to its set value).
description: Remove an envelope (the parameter returns to its set value).  See describe for errors and examples.

name: env_set
title: Set an envelope's options: active (heard), mode (read, touch, latch, write).
description: Set an envelope's options: active (heard), mode (read, touch, latch, write).  See describe for errors and examples.

name: fx_add
title: Insert a plugin into a track's FX chain and return its id.
description: Insert a plugin into a track's FX chain and return its id. plugin: id or name from plugin.list; patch: an initial (partial) patch for semantic plugins. See describe for errors and examples.

name: fx_describe
title: Describe a plugin instance in words; full adds its parameters and patch.
description: Describe a plugin instance in words; full adds its parameters and patch.  See describe for errors and examples.

name: fx_param_set
title: Set plugin parameters by key in physical units: {"cutoff": "800 Hz"}.
description: Set plugin parameters by key in physical units: {"cutoff": "800 Hz"}.  See describe for errors and examples.

name: fx_patch_merge
title: Merge a partial patch into a plugin instance; returns the effective change.
description: Merge a partial patch into a plugin instance; returns the effective change. Semantic plugins only. Values in physical units: {"params": {"gain": "-6 dB"}}. See describe for errors and examples.

name: fx_remove
title: Remove a plugin instance (and its envelopes).
description: Remove a plugin instance (and its envelopes).  See describe for errors and examples.

name: fx_restart
title: Re-create a plugin instance from its saved patch/state (after a crash).
description: Re-create a plugin instance from its saved patch/state (after a crash). engine.status lists failed_fx: isolated plugins whose process crashed or hung. The new instance starts from the model's patch or state. See describe for errors and examples.

name: fx_set
title: Set instance options: bypass, offline, wet (%), label, isolation.
description: Set instance options: bypass, offline, wet (%), label, isolation. isolation: in_process, dedicated (the plugin runs in a process of its own: a crash silences only it), shared_bridge (one process for all such plugins), inherit (the project default: in_process). See describe for errors and examples.

wet.description: Quantity strings are range-checked by the server. (%; accepts quantity strings)

name: history_list
title: List the current branch's recent versions (newest first).
description: List the current branch's recent versions (newest first).  See describe for errors and examples.

name: history_redo
title: Redo the last undone change.
description: Redo the last undone change.  See describe for errors and examples.

name: history_undo
title: Undo the last change on the current branch.
description: Undo the last change on the current branch.  See describe for errors and examples.

name: item_add
title: Add an item on a track: MIDI written in notation, or an audio file.
description: Add an item on a track: MIDI written in notation, or an audio file. position in beats (quarter notes from the start) or bar (1-based). notation: e.g. "voice bass; 1: C2:q r:q C2:q r:q | F2:h G2:h" — every bar must add up; the item is as long as the written bars unless length (beats) is given. audio_file: a path at the project's sample rate. See describe for errors and examples.

name: item_move
title: Move an item in time (position in beats or bar) and/or to another track.
description: Move an item in time (position in beats or bar) and/or to another track.  See describe for errors and examples.

name: item_remove
title: Remove an item with its takes (unpooled sources go too).
description: Remove an item with its takes (unpooled sources go too).  See describe for errors and examples.

name: midi_get
title: Read an item's MIDI as notation.
description: Read an item's MIDI as notation.  See describe for errors and examples.

name: midi_write
title: Replace an item's MIDI with notation (the item keeps its position and length).
description: Replace an item's MIDI with notation (the item keeps its position and length).  See describe for errors and examples.

name: project_get
title: Show the project: name, rate, tempo, meter, file, version and branch.
description: Show the project: name, rate, tempo, meter, file, version and branch. recoverable: recordings a crash left out of the project (project.recoverable). See describe for errors and examples.

name: project_open
title: Open a project file (replaces the current project and its history).
description: Open a project file (replaces the current project and its history). recoverable > 0: recordings a crash left out of the project; project.recoverable lists them and project.recover puts them back. See describe for errors and examples.

name: project_recover
title: Put recordings a crash left out back into the project (one undo step).
description: Put recordings a crash left out back into the project (one undo step). files: as project.recoverable lists them (omit for all). Each becomes an item on the track it was recorded on (or track) at the position it was recorded. See describe for errors and examples.

name: project_recoverable
title: List recordings a crash left out of the project.
description: List recordings a crash left out of the project. Takes recorded but never committed (the program stopped mid-recording) or never saved, found in the media folder's rec/. start_seconds is where each was recorded; seconds includes audio written after the file's last header update. See describe for errors and examples.

name: project_save
title: Save the project (canonical JSON) to its file or a new path.
description: Save the project (canonical JSON) to its file or a new path. path: where to save (becomes the project's file); omit to save in place. See describe for errors and examples.

name: project_set
title: Change project metadata (name, title, author, notes, pan law).
description: Change project metadata (name, title, author, notes, pan law).  See describe for errors and examples.

pan_law_db.description: Quantity strings are range-checked by the server. (dB; accepts quantity strings)

name: render_mix
title: Render the mix offline to a float WAV (default: start to the last item's end).
description: Render the mix offline to a float WAV (default: start to the last item's end). start_beat/end_beat in beats; tail_s seconds after the end (reverb tails). See describe for errors and examples.

name: session_describe
title: Describe the whole session in compact text (tracks, items, fx, routes).
description: Describe the whole session in compact text (tracks, items, fx, routes). The quickest way to see where things are; use the IDs it shows with other commands. See describe for errors and examples.

name: tempo_set
title: Replace the tempo map: points {beat, bpm, ramp?}; the first must be at beat 0.
description: Replace the tempo map: points {beat, bpm, ramp?}; the first must be at beat 0. ramp: true changes the tempo linearly (in beats) to the next point; otherwise it steps. See describe for errors and examples.

bpm.description: Quantity strings are range-checked by the server.

name: timesig_set
title: Set the meter from a bar on, e.g. {"bar": 9, "meter": "3/4"}.
description: Set the meter from a bar on, e.g. {"bar": 9, "meter": "3/4"}.  See describe for errors and examples.

name: track_add
title: Add a track (under the master, or inside a folder track) and return its id.
description: Add a track (under the master, or inside a folder track) and return its id. parent: a track id to nest under (it becomes a folder); index: position among its siblings. See describe for errors and examples.

name: track_list
title: List tracks in tree order with their level, mute/solo, fx and items.
description: List tracks in tree order with their level, mute/solo, fx and items.  See describe for errors and examples.

name: track_remove
title: Remove a track with its items, fx, routes and envelopes (not a folder).
description: Remove a track with its items, fx, routes and envelopes (not a folder).  See describe for errors and examples.

name: track_set
title: Set track fields: name, volume_db, pan, width, mute, solo, color, notes, arming.
description: Set track fields: name, volume_db, pan, width, mute, solo, color, notes, arming. Only the given fields change. solo: off | on | in_place | defeat. armed + record_input (device input channels, 1-based) prepare a track for transport.record; monitor: off | on | auto (auto: while armed) — a monitored track hears its input live, also while stopped. See describe for errors and examples.

volume_db.description: Quantity strings are range-checked by the server. (dB; accepts quantity strings)

pan.description: Quantity strings are range-checked by the server. (%; accepts quantity strings)

width.description: Quantity strings are range-checked by the server. (%; accepts quantity strings)

name: transport_get
title: The play position and whether it is playing.
description: The play position and whether it is playing.  See describe for errors and examples.

name: transport_pause
title: Pause playback where it is (ends a recording).
description: Pause playback where it is (ends a recording).  See describe for errors and examples.

name: transport_play
title: Start playback from the current position.
description: Start playback from the current position.  See describe for errors and examples.

name: transport_record
title: Play and record every armed track's input.
description: Play and record every armed track's input.  See describe for errors and examples.

name: transport_seek
title: Move the play position (one of seconds, beat or bar).
description: Move the play position (one of seconds, beat or bar).  See describe for errors and examples.

name: transport_stop
title: Stop playback and return to where it started (ends a recording).
description: Stop playback and return to where it started (ends a recording).  See describe for errors and examples.
